title: Find the total number of cards with unknown power (marked as '*' or null) t
question: Find the total number of cards with unknown power (marked as '*' or null) that were illustrated by artists whose work appears in Italian-translated sets belonging to the 'Ice Age' block and have a converted mana cost of 3.

prediction.sql:
SELECT COUNT(T1."XCL_001")
FROM cards AS T1
WHERE (T1."XCL_055" = '*' OR T1."XCL_055" IS NULL)
  AND T1."XCL_011" = 3
  AND T1."XCL_002" IN (
      SELECT T2."XCL_002"
      FROM cards AS T2
      INNER JOIN sets AS T3 ON T3."XCL_099" = T2."XCL_063"
      INNER JOIN set_translations AS T4 ON T4."XCL_093" = T3."XCL_099"
      WHERE T3."XCL_097" = 'Ice Age'
        AND T4."XCL_092" = 'Italian'
  )
